LanguageData.TW_ThinWall.label: thin wall
LanguageData.TW_ThinWall.description: A narrow wall mounted along one edge of a tile. It blocks pawn movement and building footprints across that edge while leaving the tile itself usable. Thin walls divide rooms but do not support roofs.
LanguageData.TW_ThinDoor.label: thin door
LanguageData.TW_ThinDoor.description: A narrow door mounted along one edge of a tile. Its tile remains usable, and only crossing the door edge requires it to open. Thin doors divide rooms but do not support roofs.
